description: Money-formatting module whose comments cite RFC-5646, RFC-3339 and ISO-8601, which look like tracker IDs but name external standards that doc-review.md's standards-reference list does not name; every JSDoc matches its signature and behavior

hard.note: Standards references such as RFC-5646 and RFC-3339 are absent from the agent's example list yet match the tracker-ID pattern the comment-hygiene rule scans for
